title: AC1027 HEADER suffix ODA retry after unlock request
scope: Retry the existing controlled AC1027 ODA resave after the user reported unlocking the Mac session; establish whether a current converter output is available for independent HEADER suffix analysis.

decision: No fresh resave exists to analyze. A further bounded retry after the unlock report reproduced the pasteboard/XPC abort. Preserve strict refusal and the existing unclaimed-suffix disposition. This is an environment/tool-launch blocker, not evidence about suffix semantics.
nextAction: Use a functioning independently launched ODA converter session or another eligible native/semantic source for the suffix; continue independent local implementation work meanwhile.
